source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. Battle with the great guardian of a region: an ancient, mythic monster that has swallowed the region's great beacon fire; winning relights the beacon. Grand, heroic and weighty, a decisive battle with a mythic beast; more epic and majestic than an ordinary boss battle, but earthly rather than cosmic. A strong, memorable brass melody with heroic defiance. Tempo 156 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor. Instrumentation: heroic horns and trumpets melody, driving string ostinato, timpani, war drums, low wordless choir pads (no words), electric bass, organ swells, cymbal crashes. Form: brass fanfare intro; driving riff; section A heroic brass theme; section B tense bridge with low choir and timpani; section A again bigger; the last bar leads back to the riff. Duration: 100 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
